title: Quantifying the cost of construction size for genetic programming in single-operator grammars: code, data and results
description: Code, data and results of a preregistered study of how a target's shortest construction, proven by exhaustive enumeration, relates to how often genetic programming recovers the target exactly. It covers seven single-operator grammars of the EML type and four held-out grammars. The record holds the grammars and exhaustive enumerator, tree GP and a (1+4) evolution strategy, every run record, the registered and post hoc analyses and their outputs, and a script that checks the code and data against the versions registered on OSF.
